text: For seed 21 (m2 fixed, data_seed 1), the N=64 minus N=128 layer-1 force gap is 0.054 at matched horizon (24000 steps) but only about 0.038-0.042 at matched val_mse_ratio (about 0.004, N=64 steps 14000-16000). If the N=128 seed-21 24000-step trajectory and this run are both plotted as layer-1 control plus margin against log(val_mse_ratio), is there a constant offset of at least 0.04, or are the curves converging?
